sv.title: Nu sitter Värmekyrkans adventsljus på plats
sv.summary: Under fredagsförmiddagen monterades adventsljusen på Värmekyrkans tak i Norrköping. Ett populärt landmärke som lyst upp staden i juletid sedan millennieskiftet.

en.title: Värmekyrkan's Advent lights are now in place
en.summary: On Friday morning the Advent lights were mounted on the roof of Värmekyrkan in Norrköping. A popular landmark that has lit up the city at Christmas since the turn of the millennium.
